title: ccp_select_channel_endianness.json:5: Incorrect output range documentation
description: Line 5 states 'Output range is [1, n_channels-1] inclusive' but this is mathematically false when n_channels=2. The formula 'channel = 1 + (hash % max(n_channels - 1, 2))' with n_channels=2 gives n=max(1,2)=2, so channel is in [1,2]. But the claimed range [1, n_channels-1] = [1, 1] for n_channels=2. The test vector 'n_channels_clamped_to_2' (line 108-125) explicitly demonstrates output channel=2 with n_channels=2, violating the stated invariant. Fix: Change description to 'Output range is [1, max(n_channels - 1, 2)] inclusive'.
close_reason: Fixed documentation: changed 'Output range is [1, n_channels-1] inclusive' to 'Output range is [1, max(n_channels - 1, 2)] inclusive' to correctly reflect the clamping formula
